title: Deterministic multi-view DINOv2 invariance screen
hypothesis: Averaging complementary deterministic views before RBF classification reduces pose and resize sensitivity in few-shot fine-grained recognition.

views.stretch: resize directly to 392x392; frozen PAT-H-260729-001 feature
views.stretch_flip: resize directly to 392x392 then horizontal flip
views.center: resize shorter edge to 448 then center crop 392x392

selection_rule.screen_success: best multi-view arm improves balanced accuracy by at least 0.50 percentage points
selection_rule.confirmation: If passed, freeze the winning view recipe and evaluate on two newly generated untouched train-only episodes.
